results.title: Portugal parties propose fuel tax reductions and price controls
results.description: Proposed amendments to the 2027 State Budget include fuel tax reductions, price caps and additional support for consumers and farmers.

results.title: Ruto Credits Fertiliser Subsidies for Doubling Maize Production to 71 Million Bags
results.description: President William Ruto has attributed a sharp increase in Kenya’s maize production to the government’s fertiliser subsidy programme, saying output rose from 34.3 million bags in 2022 to 71 million bags in 2025. results.title: North Korea completes external works on enrichment facility extension, says IAEA
results.description: A new extension to North Korea's Yongbyon enrichment facility has been "externally complete" since mid-October, according to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), which relies on satellite imagery and open sources to monitor the country's nuclear programme. IAEA chief Rafael Grossi on Wednesday said expansion of Pyongyang's enrichment programme remains "cause for serious concern".
